concept.title: The Echoes of Rengulch
concept.logline: On sunlit, melancholy Rengulch, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the echo keys and restore the Rim Watchtower.
concept.source_prompt: Sandstone Steps. mesa sandstone terraces ledges puzzle Beacon circuit
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Trailhead Post and becomes the one who brings the Rim Watchtower back to life.

key_locations.name: Trailhead Post
key_locations.description: The start: a trading post at the canyon mouth.

key_locations.name: Echo Cave
key_locations.description: Echo Cave: a cave of Rengulch, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

key_locations.name: Cottonwood Wash
key_locations.description: Cottonwood Wash: a grove on the way out from Trailhead Post.

key_locations.name: Cliff Dwellings
key_locations.description: Cliff Dwellings: a ruin on the way out from Trailhead Post.

key_locations.name: Rim Watchtower
key_locations.description: Rim Watchtower: a tower of Rengulch, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

characters.name: Sheriff Maren
characters.description: Waits in Trailhead Post and knows why the Rim Watchtower fell silent.

characters.name: Kai the Ranger
characters.description: Follows you from Trailhead Post and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Gorge Warden
characters.description: A gorge warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Ember the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Rengulch for anything shiny.

characters.name: Dust Lizard
characters.description: A harmless dust lizard that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Learn the order of the circuit
hazards: Sheer drops off the trail edges

actions.value: On sunlit, melancholy Rengulch, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the echo keys and restore the Rim Watchtower.
Light the beacons in order: Cottonwood Wash, then the Rim Watchtower.
Next in the circuit: the Cottonwood Wash.
The circuit is closed. The Rim Watchtower answers.
Every beacon burns. The Echoes of Rengulch is lit again.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: So you've come to Trailhead Post at last. I am Sheriff Maren. On sunlit, melancholy Rengulch, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the echo keys and restore the Rim Watchtower.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: Back again. Trailhead Post is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: Go to Echo Cave, then Cottonwood Wash. Whatever still remembers The Echoes of Rengulch is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Trailhead Post, The Echoes of Rengulch was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Curious, even then.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: Echo Cave: Echo Cave: a cave of Rengulch, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Echoes of Rengulch back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Maren
nodes.text: Cottonwood Wash: Cottonwood Wash: a grove on the way out from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Ranger
nodes.text: Kai the Ranger circles your feet, then looks toward Cottonwood Wash as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Ranger
nodes.text: Kai the Ranger sniffs the air. Something about Cottonwood Wash has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Ranger
nodes.text: It turns toward Cottonwood Wash. Cottonwood Wash: a grove on the way out from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Gorge Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Gorge Warden, of the watch at Trailhead Post. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Gorge Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Gorge Warden
nodes.text: Sheer drops off the trail edges. Worst near Echo Cave.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Trailhead Post. Ember the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Echoes of Rengulch that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Cliff Dwellings after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Dust Lizard
nodes.text: The dust lizard freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
